correctness.rationale: The odd-part digit recurrences are exact. For A+A all four residue classes have explicit constructive induction. The mixed sumset has constructive coverage except 0,1,4, checked as genuinely nonrepresentable. For B+B, all odd residues except 1,3,5,9 and all positive multiples of four are covered, and the equivalence 4m+2 in B+B iff 2m in B+B follows from parity/residue constraints. Descending reduction on the remaining even class reaches zero exactly on 2^k-2, yielding the complete infinite family. The exact count follows from counting powers of two. Actual standalone test covers constructive witnesses to n<100000 and independently direct sumsets to n<8192, but these finite tests are supplemental to the symbolic universal proof.

value.rationale: This classifies all three natural pairwise two-integer sumsets of the complementary sign-position sets of regular paperfolding, exhibiting universally representable, finitely obstructed, and infinitely logarithmically obstructed behavior. The exact exceptional set and sharp counting law answer a motivated additive-basis problem for a classical automatic sequence; they are neither a mere finite numerical table nor a restatement of its familiar index recurrence.
